channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on IT services in Indian markets. Today: strong tailwind (+3.0).

item.title: [+2] IT index jumps about 4% as Sensex gains 414 points to 74,729.27; IT has best week since 2008
item.description:
Nifty rose 0.65% to 23,146.15 for a second day of gains. Better-than-expected results and deal wins from IT firms drove the IT index up about 11.7% this week. Midcaps slipped. Escalating rally.

IT services: tailwind (+2) — Best week since 2008

Why it matters: Results showing steadier demand and deal wins ease fears of AI-led disruption, lifting a large index weight; the weak rupee adds to IT earnings.

Market gauges: Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] US waives Russia-linked sanctions and tariffs that threatened 100% duties on India over Russian oil
item.description:
The order came two days before the law's measures took effect; it also covers China and three others. The waiver is temporary and existing Russia sanctions stay. Russia supplied about 45% of India's crude in August. Reverses an escalating threat.

IT services: mild tailwind (+1) — Lower trade friction with US

Why it matters: Removing the 100% tariff threat protects Indian exports to the US and lets refiners keep buying discounted Russian crude, easing the import bill and trade risk ahead of the US Secretary of State's visit.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1, Fiscal & trade balance +1, Rupee +1

Confidence: high · horizon: months
